title: Three Weeks and One Short Basket
subtitle: 经济消费 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 经济消费（人与社会·社会服务与人际沟通·经济与消费）
meta: 主题语境：经济消费（人与社会·社会服务与人际沟通·经济与消费）　|　核心词汇：purchase　|　正文 344 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 purchase 的含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1973 the trader ① made the purchase that no partner in the market would have measured, and he said the making was the whole of the week. The ② purchase, meaning the deal itself and not the basket, ran three weeks and stayed unmeasured in the book; a purchase, he said, is the only thing in a market that is judged by how long it is left unmeasured.

Every ③ purchase in that market had the same short basket beside it, and the ④ purchase at the far stall, meaning the sample they kept for the children to show and not either of those, was the only one anybody ever thanked twice. A purchase, my mother said, is nine parts patience and one part somebody willing to measure; the trader said the measuring is the part that fills three weeks.

My uncle meant the other thing entirely: he said ⑤ the purchase was the whole of the matter, meaning the cost and not the deal. The ⑥ purchase, meaning the cost and not any of that, is the only thing in a matter that everybody waits for and nobody measures; purchase, he said, is either something you make or the only word that means both a deal and a cost. He said the cost is the part they remember.

By 1978 the ⑦ purchase had become a line in a list, and the list had become an argument about the short basket. The ⑧ purchase of the whole thing, the trader wrote in October, was one market and three weeks of measuring; purchase, he said, is either the sample at the far stall or the reason you learned to measure. He said the measuring was never mentioned.

The ⑨ purchase I remember is the deal measured in the list, which closed in 1980 and is still measured as the quietest in the market. A ⑩ purchase, my mother said in 1982, is the only deal that improves by being measured; every purchase, she said, is a cost that has agreed to look like a deal. She said the cost was the honest half.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请将对应义项填入表中。
options: A. n. 购买；买到的东西（指集市里每一笔旁边的那一笔）
B. n. 购买；买到的东西（指那笔购买本身，与小小的货篮相对）
C. 固定搭配：make the purchase 添置这一笔购买
D. n. 购买；买到的东西（指留给孩子们给人看的那一份）
E. n. 购买之事（抽象总称，指一处集市的购买之事）
F. n. 购买；买到的东西（指货单里写到、被测量的那一笔）
G. n. 购买、花销（指一件事里人人都卖却无人提起的那样东西）
H. n. 花销（抽象总称，指人人都卖却无人提起的那样东西）

items.q: made the purchase that no partner in the market would have measured
The purchase, meaning the deal itself and not the basket
the purchase at the far stall
the purchase was the whole of the matter
the purchase had become a line in a list
The purchase of the whole thing
A purchase, my mother said in 1982

answers.why: make the purchase 意为“添置这一笔购买”，1973 年那位货商把集市里没有一位伙计肯测量的一笔购买做了一遍。
purchase 意为“购买；买到的东西”，指那笔购买本身而不是小小的货篮，它经过了三个星期而在簿子上没有被测量。
purchase 意为“购买；买到的东西”，指集市里每一笔旁边的那一笔，每一笔旁边都有同一只小小的货篮。
purchase 意为“购买；买到的东西”，指最远那个摊子的留给孩子们给人看的那一份，是唯一有人谢过两次的。
purchase 意为“购买、花销”，指一件事里人人都卖却无人提起的那样东西，叔叔说这笔花销就是那件事的全部。
purchase 意为“花销”，指人人都卖却无人提起的那样东西而不是那笔购买，是事情里人人都等、却无人说破的东西。
purchase 意为“购买；买到的东西”，指货单里写到、被测量的那一笔，到 1978 年这一笔成了货单里的一行。
purchase 意为“购买之事”，货商十月写道，整件事的购买之事是一处集市和三个星期的测量。
purchase 意为“购买；买到的东西”，我记得的是货单里测量过的那一笔，1980 年批完了，至今仍被说成集市里最安静的一笔。
purchase 为抽象总称，母亲 1982 年说，购买是唯一会因为被好好测量而变得更好的购买。
